result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, during business hours, through an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, with no direct or remote system access. Section 22.2 retains Vendor-paid costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%. The added off-site and records-and-reports mechanics reasonably implement the no-system-access requirement without altering unrelated commercial terms, and the drafting is clear and professional.
